items.title: Knitted Snowman with Earflap Hat
items.alt: Cream knitted snowman plush with a rust-colored earflap hat, green scarf, brown mittens and wooden buttons.
items.description: Chunky stitches, small hat tassels and stitched mitten edges emphasize the rounded toy’s looped yarn texture.

items.title: Snowman Face on a Wood-Slice Ornament
items.alt: Round bark-edged wood ornament painted with a smiling snowman face and teal top hat, hanging beneath a red gingham bow.
items.description: The complete twine loop sits above the broad bow, with the painted face centered on the pale wood.

items.title: Three Felt Snowmen on a Garland
items.alt: Curved red cord holding three stitched felt snowmen with different hats, scarves and twig arms.
items.description: The left charm wears red mittens, the slender middle charm has a tall red hat, and the broad right charm carries a broom.

items.title: Snowman in a Burgundy Snow Globe
items.alt: Clear snow globe containing a waving snowman in a blue cap and orange scarf, above a burgundy base with a silver snowflake.
items.description: White snow flecks sit inside the rounded glass dome while silver trim outlines the stepped base.

items.title: Paper Snowman Pop-Up Card
items.alt: Open pale blue card with a faceted paper snowman, green pointed hat, red scarf and two folded evergreen trees.
items.description: The angular snowballs and raised branch arms stand out from the flat card, with all four outer corners visible.

items.title: Snowman Offering Seeds Beside a Birdhouse
items.alt: Seated snowman in a plum knitted hat and cream scarf holding seeds beside a snow-covered gingerbread-style birdhouse.
items.description: A small red heart decorates the snowman's chest, matching the berries on the birdhouse post.
